description.text: A product's recipe as a partial order (proposed): the steps that make (Assembly) or take apart (Disassembly) the product, each step after the steps it needs, with the joints it makes or breaks. An AAS holds at most one sequence of each archetype. The recipe names no equipment.
Assembly or Disassembly: what the sequence does with its subject.
Counts the saved changes of the sequence.
The name shown for the sequence.
The AAS of the product the sequence plans.
The nodes of the sequence.

One node of the sequence. Kind step: a process of the product. Kind call: the sequence of a part of the bill of material. Kind partial: steps that run in any order their ProcessOrders allow. Kind parallel: branches that all join. Kind conditional: steps that only run when the condition holds. Kind decision: one of two branches, by the condition.
Identifies the node within its sequence.
step, call, partial, parallel, conditional or decision.
The name shown for the node.
Position among the nodes beside it. In a partial block, an order that respects its ProcessOrders: the default the steps run in.
Kind step: how long the step is expected to take, in seconds, for scheduling.
Kind step: the AAS whose process the step runs, where it is not the Subject.
Kind step: the process, in the owner's Process Parameters.
Kind step: the capabilities the step requires, where they differ from those of its process.
A Required capability in a Capability Description.
Kind step: the joints the step makes (Assembly) or breaks (Disassembly).

A joint between two parts of the bill of material (first and second, entities of the Hierarchical Structures of the AAS that holds the step). What kind of joint it is, is also its supplemental semantic id.
The kind of joint, as the joint tools name it: Screw, Plug, Bolt, Clip, PressFit, Crimp.
The standard the joint is made to, e.g. DIN 8593-3.
A joint defined in the product's sequence of the other archetype.
Kind step: what the step reports when done, for a decision to compare.
One value the step reports.
Identifies the output within its step.
The name shown for the output.
The type of the value, e.g. xs:double, xs:boolean.
The unit of the value.

Kind call: the part whose own sequence is run, an entity of the Hierarchical Structures of the AAS that holds the step. Its asset id leads to the part's AAS; the sequence run is that AAS's sequence of the same ArcheType.
Kind call: identifies this use of the part, where the bill of material holds it more than once (a Quantity above 1).
Kind conditional and decision: when the guarded steps run, or which branch is taken.
everyNthProduct, or comparison (an output against Expected).
everyNthProduct: every how many products.
everyNthProduct: what the count runs over, e.g. productionRun.
comparison: lessThan, lessOrEqual, equal, greaterOrEqual, greaterThan.
comparison: the unit of Expected.
comparison: the value the output is compared with.
The type of the value.
The value.
comparison: the output compared.
output: the output of a step done before.
The NodeId of the step.
The OutputId of its output.
Kind partial and conditional: the steps inside, each a Step as described here.
Kind partial: the order of the steps inside, one relation for each pair that must keep its order. A step that no relation has as second is ready when the block starts.
first must be done before second starts. Both are steps of this block (their collections in its Steps).
Why the order holds, e.g. a joint in the way, access, an order fixed by GMP.
Kind parallel and decision: the branches. A decision has two: Order 0 when the condition holds, Order 1 when not.
One branch.
Identifies the branch.
The name shown for the branch.
Position among the branches.
The steps of the branch, each a Step as described here.
